title: Scope Architecture

manager_rebase.reason: Live Agent Mesh advanced before Pass 3; Passes 1-2 were forward-ported onto Manager Merge 19 before implementation.

changes: Added explicit global/company/user/device/session settings scope contract.
Added scope runtime validation and canonical scoped storage-key construction.
Required company_id for every non-global scope.
Rejected tenant_id and tenant_company_id as direct scope inputs.
Mapped every Pass 2 registry setting into exactly one scope.
Kept identity/role/authority fields outside settings scope authority.
